issues.title: Incorrect tauri version in metadata file
issues.description: The metadata-v2.json file specifies tauri version as "2.8.2" but the actual tauri crate version is "2.8.3" as shown in crates/tauri/Cargo.toml. This version mismatch will cause the CLI to report incorrect version information to tools and scripts that depend on this metadata. The PR updated the tauri version to 2.8.3, but the metadata file was not updated accordingly, creating an inconsistency between the actual library version and the advertised version.

issues.title: Dependency version mismatch for tauri-bundler
issues.description: The tauri-cli Cargo.toml declares a dependency on tauri-bundler version "2.6.0", but the actual tauri-bundler crate version is "2.6.1" as specified in crates/tauri-bundler/Cargo.toml. This creates a version constraint mismatch that could cause build failures or prevent the CLI from using the updated bundler with the bug fix for 32-bit Windows builds. The CHANGELOG indicates this version should have been updated to 2.6.1 to pick up the binary patching fix.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #14070 - Apply Version Updates From Current Changes

structured_output.summary:
This is a release-automation PR. It consumes three `.changes/*.md` change files (tauri-bundler patch, tauri patch, and the CLI dependency bump) and applies the resulting version bumps: tauri-bundler 2.6.0→2.6.1, tauri 2.8.2→2.8.3, tauri-cli 2.8.0→2.8.1, and @tauri-apps/cli 2.8.1→2.8.2. It also adds CHANGELOG sections for each package, updates the config schema `$id` to 2.8.3, and regenerates the Cargo.lock entries for the new versions.

The core version and changelog work is consistent: the package versions match their changelog headings, the CLI npm package and `metadata-v2.json`'s `cli.js` entry agree on 2.8.2, and the schema `$id` follows the tauri crate version. Three things go beyond a pure version bump: a stale `"tauri": "2.8.2"` in `metadata-v2.json`, an unexplained `homepage` field added to tauri-bundler, and lockfile edges moving from windows-sys 0.48 to 0.59 for three crates. The first looks like a real miss, and the other two should either be called out or split out.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The version and changelog bumps are correct, but the stale `"tauri": "2.8.2"` entry in the CLI metadata file is a release-correctness miss that should be fixed before publishing. The unrelated homepage addition and Cargo.lock churn are low-risk but unexplained in a release PR, so they should be reverted or documented. Nothing here is a security or runtime-behavior risk.

architecture.overview:
Tauri's release flow is driven by `.changes/*.md` files. Each file names a package and a bump level, and the release tooling uses them to compute new versions, write the per-crate CHANGELOG.md sections, and update manifests and lockfiles. In this PR the change files are deleted and their effects are applied directly to the manifests, so the versions move from 2.8.2/2.6.0/2.8.0/2.8.1 to 2.8.3/2.6.1/2.8.1/2.8.2.

The PR also touches artifacts that embed the tauri version. `crates/tauri-cli/config.schema.json` (generated from `tauri-schema-generator`) carries the schema `$id` URL, which tracks the tauri crate version. `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json` lists the versions of the CLI JS wrapper and of the tauri, tauri-build and tauri-plugin packages. The PR updates the CLI wrapper and schema entries but leaves the `tauri` entry in the metadata file at 2.8.2.
steps: Start at the release inputs: three deleted `.changes/*.md` files (tauri-bundler patch, tauri patch, tauri-cli dependency bump) that define what gets released.

Follow the manifest bumps: `crates/tauri/Cargo.toml` (2.8.3), `crates/tauri-bundler/Cargo.toml` (2.6.1, plus a new `homepage` line), `crates/tauri-cli/Cargo.toml` (2.8.1), and `packages/cli/package.json` (2.8.2).
Check the derived artifacts: the new CHANGELOG sections in each crate, the schema `$id` in `config.schema.json` moved to 2.8.3, and `metadata-v2.json` updated for `cli.js` only.

Review the lockfile: `Cargo.lock` gets the new package versions for tauri, tauri-bundler and tauri-cli, plus three dependency-edge changes (colored, libloading, winapi-util) from windows-sys 0.48/windows-targets 0.48 to 0.59/0.52 that are not part of the release inputs.

findings.title: metadata-v2.json still lists tauri 2.8.2 after the 2.8.3 bump
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json`, the `"tauri"` field (line 6) still says `2.8.2`, but the tauri crate was bumped to `2.8.3` in this PR (`crates/tauri/Cargo.toml`) and the schema `$id` was also moved to 2.8.3. Update the `"tauri"` value to `"2.8.3"`, matching the way `cli.js` was bumped in the same file. First check how this file is generated or consumed (search the repo for `metadata-v2`) to confirm it is meant to track the latest tauri release. Do not change `tauri-build` or `tauri-plugin`, which are not part of this release.

findings.title: Unrelated `homepage` field added to tauri-bundler
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-bundler/Cargo.toml`, the `homepage = "https://tauri.app/"` line (line 12) was added in a release PR that otherwise only bumps versions. Either remove it from this PR and land it separately, or keep it and add a matching note. If it stays, match the form used by `crates/tauri-cli/Cargo.toml` (`https://tauri.app`, no trailing slash) for consistency. Check whether `crates/tauri/Cargo.toml` uses `homepage.workspace = true` and whether the bundler should do the same.

findings.title: Unexplained windows-sys dependency-edge churn in Cargo.lock
findings.fixPrompt: In `Cargo.lock`, the `colored` (around line 1322), `libloading` (around line 4314) and `winapi-util` (around line 10314) package entries changed their windows-sys / windows-targets dependency versions (0.48 to 0.59, and 0.48.5 to 0.52.6). This release PR should only update the versions of tauri, tauri-bundler and tauri-cli. Regenerate the lockfile so it only contains those version changes (for example, revert these three edges and rerun `cargo update -p tauri -p tauri-bundler -p tauri-cli --precise` or the equivalent in the release tooling), then confirm `cargo metadata` and a build still succeed. If the upgrade is intended, call it out in the PR description.

findings.title: tauri-cli still pins tauri-bundler to req 2.6.0
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-cli/Cargo.toml`, the path dependency `tauri-bundler` on line 50 still uses `version = "2.6.0"`. The tauri-cli 2.8.1 CHANGELOG entry says it upgraded to `tauri-bundler@2.6.1`, and tauri-bundler is now 2.6.1 in `crates/tauri-bundler/Cargo.toml`. Change the requirement to `version = "2.6.1"` so the published manifest matches the release notes. Keep `default-features = false` and the `path` attribute as they are. Then run `cargo check -p tauri-cli` to confirm the lockfile still resolves.

findings.title: Version bumps, changelogs and schema ID are consistent
findings.body: The release mechanics line up. The four package versions match their changelog headings. `packages/cli/package.json` (2.8.2) agrees with `cli.js` in `metadata-v2.json` (2.8.2). The schema `$id` in `crates/tauri-cli/config.schema.json` and in `crates/tauri-schema-generator/schemas/config.schema.json` is updated to 2.8.3 in both places, which matches the tauri crate. The consumed `.changes/*.md` files are removed, so they won't be released twice. The new changelog sections follow the existing format in each file.
